text_block_list.text:
On my day off, Taiki Shuttle invited me to 
go buy cosmetics at the mall—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So you really don't sell it here, huh~ 
Nothing else will do, desu kedo..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... At this rate, my skin is going to 
turn into a Wild West dessert--...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... so far, I haven't seen any in 
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I guess I have no choice but to 
wait for the Family to send it to me, 
huh~?
